mode-path-desc: Hold right mouse (default 1.5 seconds): press a loose stone into soil to make a stone path. With Rainbow Roads Updated, loose stones on gravel make colored paths matching the stone. Bare soil can be compacted and rammed in stages.
mode-compact-desc: Hold right mouse on the top face for about 2 seconds: soil → packed dirt → selected rammed earth. Does not consume loose stones to make paths.
mode-originalshovel-desc: Use the shovel's original interactions. Left-click digging works in all modes.
mode-stairs-desc: Hold on a stone path block or slab's top face (default 0.5 seconds) to shape stairs; work on stairs again to restore a regular path. Supports Rainbow Roads Updated paths, preserving rock type. Uses native orientation; costs 1 durability. Release between steps.
mode-slab-desc: Hold on a stone path block or stairs' top face (default 0.5 seconds) to shape a slab; work on a slab again to restore a regular path. Supports Rainbow Roads Updated paths, preserving rock type. Costs 1 durability; release between steps.
mode-loosen-desc: Hold on the top face for about 1.5 seconds: any vanilla rammed earth type → packed dirt → low-fertility soil. Release between steps. Switch back to tilling to make farmland.
mode-settings-desc: Choose a block preview to set this shovel's rammed earth type. Keeps the current work mode. Defaults to plain.
mode-originalhoe-desc: Use the original hoe functions, including farming interactions provided by other mods.
work-error-target: Aim at the top face to start ground work.
work-error-output: No matching vanilla ground-work output is available.
work-error-recipe: No enabled recipe supports this ground work.
work-error-recipe-costs: The recipe cannot be used here, or materials/tool durability are insufficient.
work-error-obstructed: Clear the space above the target; this ground work cannot be placed here.
work-error-access: Ground work is blocked by a claim or block reinforcement.
mode-polish-desc: Hold right mouse on recipe-supported rock for 1.5 seconds, with a hammer in the offhand. Preserves the rock type and uses the recipe tool costs. Does not enter chiseling.
mode-originalchisel-desc: Use the original chisel functions and existing material modes.
work-error-wood-tools: Hold a saw in the main hand and place planks in the hotbar slot immediately to its right.
work-error-stone-tools: Select Stone surface finishing from the chisel F menu and hold a hammer in the offhand.
